posts.text:
We got extremely good at extracting a scanned from layer by layer 📋 - from printed fields, overlaid text, handwriting, and reviewer annotations.

For instance, on an annotated permit, our Extract agents can extract out both the original permit number but also any drawn/handwritten annotations on top. they're also grounded exactly in the source text. 

our agents reduce error rates by 2x+, at a small fraction of the price compared to using a frontier model.

Our Extract v2.5 agents are SOTA in price/performance, and scanned forms are just one example. Come check it out! 

Extract v2.5: https://t.co/TTlTdECU03

Available in LlamaParse: https://t.co/XYZmx5TFz8

quotedTweet.text:
Today we’re introducing Extract v2.5 - a series of frontier agents tuned for document extraction.

The agents (cost-effective, agentic, agentic plus) are tuned for value accuracy and grounding. Our extraction agents outperform Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol while being 30%-4x cheaper. 

We’ve made massive improvements on complex extraction over 
* long lists (86.1% -> 95.5% on our agentic tier)
* records spanning pages (85.5% -> 96.5%)
* scanned forms (90.9% -> 95.7%)

We’ve also launched the following features:
✅ Advanced citations: we locate bounding boxes for all supporting values for an inferred field, even if there's not an exact match.
✅ Structural Reasoning: we tailor document extraction algorithms depending on the type, layout, and information

Our extraction agents are SOTA in price-performance on ExtractBench, across a wide range of cost points. We are the best tool for document extraction across documents of any complexity.

Blog: https://t.co/TTlTdECU03

All of these are available on LlamaParse: https://t.co/XYZmx5TFz8 . Come check it out!
quotedTweet.translationZh:
今天我们推出 Extract v2.5——一系列面向文档抽取调优的前沿智能体。

这些智能体（cost-effective、agentic、agentic plus）针对数值准确性和可溯源性进行了调优。我们的抽取智能体表现优于 Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Sol，同时成本低 30% 到 4 倍。

我们在复杂抽取方面取得了大幅提升：
* 长列表（agentic 档位从 86.1% 提升到 95.5%）
* 跨页记录（85.5% -> 96.5%）
* 扫描表单（90.9% -> 95.7%）

我们还上线了以下功能：
✅ 高级引用：即使没有精确匹配，我们也能为推断字段定位所有支撑值的边界框。
✅ 结构化推理：我们会根据文档类型、版式和信息定制文档抽取算法。

在 ExtractBench 上，覆盖多个成本区间，我们的抽取智能体在性价比上达到 SOTA。对于任何复杂度的文档，我们都是最佳文档抽取工具。

博客：https://t.co/TTlTdECU03

这些都已在 LlamaParse 上可用：https://t.co/XYZmx5TFz8 。欢迎来看看！

posts.text:
Scientific discovery is one of the most exciting applications of LLMs, but we lack data & evals on the scientific process.

ScholarCatalyst captures which prior papers can advance new research on a problem, rather than citations or topical relevance.

Strikingly, even frontier models struggle to identify which prior research is helpful -- lots of room for future work!

Paper, Code, Data: https://t.co/fynHV2sx1S

quotedTweet.text:
AI can increasingly make progress on open problems like Navier-Stokes. Yet defining a new problem still relies on human research taste.

Introducing ScholarCatalyst, a benchmark built from AI researchers’ firsthand accounts of what inspired their work.
quotedTweet.translationZh:
AI 越来越能够推动 Navier-Stokes 这类开放问题取得进展。然而，定义一个新问题仍依赖人类的研究品味。

介绍 ScholarCatalyst：一个基于 AI 研究者亲述其工作灵感来源而构建的基准。

posts.translationZh:
科学发现是 LLM 最令人兴奋的应用之一，但我们缺乏关于科学过程的数据和评测。

ScholarCatalyst 关注哪些既有论文能推动某个问题的新研究，而不是引用或主题相关性。

令人惊讶的是，即使是前沿模型也难以识别哪些既有研究真正有帮助，未来还有很大提升空间！

- Mapped all 9B possible single letter genetic changes across the human genome with AlphaGenome Atlas and made it openly available to researchers.
- Billions of decisions depend on weather predictions so we introduced WeatherNext 3, our most accurate and capable global weather AI model to date.

posts.text:
we're seeing our coding agent costs decrease significantly for second month in row

longer blog on this later, but three quick steps we took

1/ cost visibility. you cant control what you cant measure. Start tracking everything to langsmith. This gives us super granular visibility into who is using what, how they are using it, etc. LangSmith supports first party integrations with all main coding harnesses https://t.co/zPHBAWaRVS

2/ cost controls. Through our LLM gateway, set user level cost caps. (You can increase your cap by talking to our VPE). This helps curb unexpected or accidental spend. https://t.co/YhvxFjTfxi

3/ optimize the harness. Obviously 3rd party harnesses are tougher to optimize, but we are doing more and more coding through OpenSWE, our open source cloud agent harness. Things like model routing help bring the cost down https://t.co/pHUDDCF6zs

feel free to reach out if you want help implementing these at your co!

posts.translationZh:
我们看到编码 agent 的成本连续第二个月显著下降。

之后会写一篇更长的博客，这里先说我们采取的三个快速步骤：

1/ 成本可见性。无法衡量就无法控制。开始把所有内容都追踪到 LangSmith。这让我们能非常细粒度地了解谁在用什么、如何使用等。LangSmith 支持与所有主要编码 harness 的第一方集成 https://t.co/zPHBAWaRVS

2/ 成本控制。通过我们的 LLM gateway 设置用户级成本上限。（你可以和我们的 VPE 沟通来提高上限。）这有助于抑制意外或误操作导致的支出。https://t.co/YhvxFjTfxi

3/ 优化 harness。显然，第三方 harness 更难优化，但我们越来越多地通过 OpenSWE 进行编码，这是我们的开源云端 agent harness。模型路由等功能有助于降低成本 https://t.co/pHUDDCF6zs

如果你想在自己的公司实现这些，欢迎联系！

posts.text:
DeepSeek Harness 这次宣布了兼容 Claude Code Mods。

负责人崔添翼  @tianyi 在知乎解释，v0.2.1-alpha.1 目前还只是实验性兼容层，不能保证 100% 兼容。官方文档也明确列出了和 Claude Code 原生行为之间的差异。

这次更像是在验证 DSH 从一开始就坚持的「一切皆插件」架构。模型、工具、Skills、Session，甚至 Agent Loop 本身都可以被替换和重新组合。

崔添翼提了三个方向，我觉得都挺关键。

用户可以用插件把 Harness 改成自己想要的样子，Agent 甚至能自己写和安装插件；企业可以把行业经验和内部基础设施沉淀成私有插件；再往前一步，插件系统还能成为 Agent 修改自身工作方式的接口。

第三点是最值得关注。

如果 Agent 以后能自己写插件、热加载插件，甚至修改自己的 Harness，那 Harness 就不再只是模型外面那层固定的壳，它会逐渐变成 Agent 可以主动修改的一部分。

所以模型可能不会把 Harness 吃掉，更可能是模型开始学会改 Harness。

而 DeepSeek Harness 团队自己给出的目标也很直接，从 Harness 的角度推进 AGI。

reviewedPosts.author: hwchase17
reviewedPosts.text:
we're seeing our coding agent costs decrease significantly for second month in row

longer blog on this later, but three quick steps we took

1/ cost visibility. you cant control what you cant measure. Start tracking everything to langsmith. This gives us super granular visibility into who is using what, how they are using it, etc. LangSmith supports first party integrations with all main coding harnesses https://t.co/zPHBAWaRVS

2/ cost controls. Through our LLM gateway, set user level cost caps. (You can increase your cap by talking to our VPE). This helps curb unexpected or accidental spend. https://t.co/YhvxFjTfxi

3/ optimize the harness. Obviously 3rd party harnesses are tougher to optimize, but we are doing more and more coding through OpenSWE, our open source cloud agent harness. Things like model routing help bring the cost down https://t.co/pHUDDCF6zs

feel free to reach out if you want help implementing these at your co!

reviewedPosts.text: Also, to be clear, creating artificial consciousness should *not* be a goal of AI research. Understanding consciousness, sure, synthesizing it, no.

reviewedPosts.author: fchollet
reviewedPosts.text:
Arguing that "consciousness arises from a computational substrate, and since AI models are computation, they are likely conscious," is as meaningless as arguing that "living creatures are made of atoms, and since this rock is made of atoms, it is likely alive."

Everything is computation. Sometimes incredibly sophisticated computation, like a chess engine, AlphaGo, google3, or the Linux kernel. That does not make it conscious. A rock being made of atoms does not confer it any of the properties we associate with living things, also made of atoms. Likewise a static input-output program that has *none* of the properties we associate with conscious beings (e.g. information integration, interoception, temporal binding, embodiment, etc.) has no more reason to be presumed conscious than a rock has to be presumed alive.

Humanity has not yet created a conscious computer program, and there are no signs we are close to doing so. When we get close, the case for machine consciousness will be backed by evidence and corroborated by consciousness science (which is a thing), not by evidence-free wishful thinking and cargo culting.
